basis: The 1850 free schedule has Sydnor Hodson, a farmer living alone, the only Hodgson in the county, and FamilySearch's family tree attaches both this entry and his 1860 one to Sydney Ludwell Hodgson, 1805-1870. Against it, the free page appears to give his age as 30, where his record's 1809 gives 40 or 41. The holding agrees with his 1860 one ten years on: a woman of 40 and boys of 12, 8 and 4 here; a woman of 50 and men of 22, 18 and 14 then. They are probably the same people; the schedule's lack of names means that cannot be shown. The second boy's age reads 10 or 11

The 1850 free schedule has Jno Fulton, 31, born in Pennsylvania, with Mossey Fulton, 23, the only John Fulton in the county; his wife Massa E. Warner Fulton is in the same Lakeview plot, N-17. His record's year-only 1817 gives 32 or 33

The 1850 free schedule has Jas Alder, 30, with Mary Alder; his stone gives 3 April 1820, and his wife Mary Jane Camp Allder is in the same Lakeview plot, N-25. His name is written on the last line of the holding above, and the line after it, numbered 1, is read as his. The index also gives him a girl of 3 from that last line; the page's numbering makes her part of the holding above, so she is not counted here
